messages.subject: sampling juvenile salmonids
parts:
Greetings,

I am trying to develop protocals for estimating abundance of juvenile =
chinook salmon in the Lower American River; snorkel surveys are commonly =
used, but usually provide somewhat weak data. =20

Has anyone used line transect sampling while snorkeling to estimate =
abundance of juvenile salmonids? or any fish species?
